notes: Patch was reconstructed against the exact official 1.1.2 release source and verified on a disposable copy.
The patch includes only source, metadata and service changes; bytecode caches are excluded.

The V1.1 change refreshes through XStream's own cache/API helpers, stages complete Movies and Series snapshots before applying provider-ID deltas in one SQLite transaction, and stores no credentials in Search.

Phase 1.5 Batch 3 derives per-series progress and fail-closed completion from XStream's existing series-change snapshot, provider episode inventory, WatchedEpisodes and ResumePoints; no second database or poller is introduced.

Phase 1.6 adds top-level Favorites/Pending routes over XStream Favorites; Pending uses separate typed folders, stable provider IDs, existing watched/completion state, and is removed only on positive completion.
Batch 2 exposes XStream's existing toggle_tmdb_watched action on provider ListItems and maps WatchedMovies read-only to Kodi PlayCount; no watched database or polling worker is added.
A fresh-provider failure or suspicious empty snapshot preserves the last valid Search index without holding the SQLite write lock during provider requests.
Search-index reconciliation compares rows from one SELECT per content type; this removes the per-provider-item N+1 SELECT while retaining transactional deltas.
The Search index reconciliation closes its SQLite connection after a transactional interruption before re-raising, preserving rollback/retry without leaking a database handle.
Unified-diff hunks use unique source context so prior patch offsets cannot insert into unrelated Python blocks.
The package builder parses every Python source before packaging and every Python member after ZIP creation.
The playback metadata adapter sets Kodi movie/episode InfoTag fields and script.trakt's supported script.trakt.ids property; it does not add OAuth, scrobbling, or alter XStream resume storage.
XStream's CC BY-NC terms prohibit treating these private patch artifacts as an unrestricted public distribution.
